# Xuanbao Environmental Technology

> Yancheng Xuanbao Environmental Technology Co., Ltd. — manufacturer of industrial
> emission control materials: SCR DeNOx catalysts, CO oxidation catalysts, VOC
> oxidation catalysts, zeolite molecular sieves and activated carbon. This file
> lists the pages of xuanbaoenvironment.com; deep technical documentation lives
> in the companion knowledge center at data.xuanbaoenvironment.com.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://xuanbaoenvironment.com/): company overview, core products, industries and R&D/quality workflow.
- [About](https://xuanbaoenvironment.com/about/): company profile, product lines, company-stated honors.
- [R&D](https://xuanbaoenvironment.com/r-and-d/): catalyst development, formula design, testing and cooperation.
- [Manufacturing](https://xuanbaoenvironment.com/manufacturing/): production process and process control.
- [Quality](https://xuanbaoenvironment.com/quality/): testing items, quality control and data classification.
- [Testing](https://xuanbaoenvironment.com/testing/): laboratory and field testing capabilities.
- [Service](https://xuanbaoenvironment.com/service/): engineering support, installation guidance and after-sales.
- [Contact](https://xuanbaoenvironment.com/contact/): inquiry form for gas conditions and quotations.
- [Resources](https://xuanbaoenvironment.com/resources/): link to the knowledge center.
- [Privacy Policy](https://xuanbaoenvironment.com/privacy/)
- [Terms of Use](https://xuanbaoenvironment.com/terms/)

## Products

- [Products](https://xuanbaoenvironment.com/products/): overview across 5 product lines.
- [SCR DeNOx Catalysts](https://xuanbaoenvironment.com/products/scr-denox-catalysts/): plate-type and honeycomb V-Mo-Ti catalysts.
  - [Honeycomb SCR Catalyst](https://xuanbaoenvironment.com/products/scr-denox-catalysts/honeycomb-scr-catalyst/)
  - [Plate-type SCR Catalyst](https://xuanbaoenvironment.com/products/scr-denox-catalysts/plate-type-scr-catalyst/)
- [VOC Catalysts](https://xuanbaoenvironment.com/products/voc-catalysts/): precious-metal honeycomb catalysts.
  - [Platinum Catalyst](https://xuanbaoenvironment.com/products/voc-catalysts/platinum-catalyst/)
  - [Platinum-Palladium Catalyst](https://xuanbaoenvironment.com/products/voc-catalysts/platinum-palladium-catalyst/)
  - [Non-precious-metal Catalyst](https://xuanbaoenvironment.com/products/voc-catalysts/non-precious-metal-catalyst/)
- [CO Removal Catalyst](https://xuanbaoenvironment.com/products/co-removal-catalyst/): CO oxidation for sintering, incineration and furnace exhaust.
- [Zeolite Molecular Sieves](https://xuanbaoenvironment.com/products/zeolite-molecular-sieve/): modified 5A, 13X, ZSM-5 and NaY.
  - [Modified 5A](https://xuanbaoenvironment.com/products/zeolite-molecular-sieve/modified-5a/)
  - [Modified 13X](https://xuanbaoenvironment.com/products/zeolite-molecular-sieve/modified-13x/)
  - [ZSM-5](https://xuanbaoenvironment.com/products/zeolite-molecular-sieve/zsm-5/)
  - [NaY](https://xuanbaoenvironment.com/products/zeolite-molecular-sieve/nay/)
- [Activated Carbon](https://xuanbaoenvironment.com/products/activated-carbon/): honeycomb, coal-based columnar, coconut shell, fruit shell and fiber.
  - [Honeycomb Activated Carbon](https://xuanbaoenvironment.com/products/activated-carbon/honeycomb-activated-carbon/)
  - [Coal-based Columnar Carbon](https://xuanbaoenvironment.com/products/activated-carbon/coal-based-columnar-carbon/)
  - [Coconut Shell Carbon](https://xuanbaoenvironment.com/products/activated-carbon/coconut-shell-carbon/)
  - [Fruit Shell Carbon](https://xuanbaoenvironment.com/products/activated-carbon/fruit-shell-carbon/)
  - [Activated Carbon Fiber](https://xuanbaoenvironment.com/products/activated-carbon/activated-carbon-fiber/)
- [Heating Tubes](https://xuanbaoenvironment.com/products/heating-tubes/): auxiliary equipment, 5000 h service life.
